note: reqclass of each class-only quest, from the quests list on each dungeon zone page of Wowhead Forever (27 zones, 569 quests read): a bit for each of the game class numbers, 1 warrior, 2 paladin, 4 hunter, 8 rogue, 16 priest, 64 shaman, 128 mage, 256 warlock, 1024 druid
rewards_note: Quests Wowhead Forever marks with no class (reqclass 0) whose only reward is an item one class can use (the item's 'classes' on the quest's page): the class is taken from the reward. Zul'Gurub's class necklaces and trinkets, and Zanza's class enchants, 27 quests, each page read 14 Nov 2026. Its other 14 quests (coins, bijous, heads, the Heart of Hakkar, the Savage Guard arcanums) are for everyone by their names; Wowhead's bot check came up before their pages were read.
pfquest_note: The class of each quest on a dungeon's zone page that pfQuest gives one (db/quests.lua, its 'class', at revision 104f35678ca39ab1fb78b655f815cc7016f5e0c8; pfQuest's database is VMaNGOS, Classic's own numbers), read 14 Nov 2026 for the 385 quests Classic has (Forever's 48 new ones aren't in it). 72 have a class. It agrees with every one of the 27 'rewards' and with 35 of 'classes'; it adds 10 Wowhead gives no class: The Emerald Dream... (druid), three of Anthion's Parting Words, and six of the Left and Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet. Where 'classes' has a quest pfQuest doesn't (Hot Fiery Death, The Demon Forge), 'classes' stands: it's Forever's own.
